description:
Its a fun game of cards for WWE legends

Step into the virtual ring of 'Battle of Cards,' the ultimate card game for WWE enthusiasts and strategy game aficionados alike. In this riveting online experience, players collect and duel with trump cards featuring iconic WWE superstars, each card boasting unique attributes that capture the essence of its wrestler. Powered by Waku node provider and built atop the robust Mantle platform, 'Battle of Cards' offers a seamless, real-time gaming experience. Engage in strategic battles, build your ultimate WWE deck, and rise through the ranks to become the champion of the digital arena. 'Battle of Cards' – where your strategic mind meets the thrilling world of WWE. Prepare to unleash your deck and dominate the game!
